metadata.title: chore: adjust diff-cover threshold and ignore Bob files
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- lower the PR diff-cover threshold from 95 to 93 and document the rationale in the workflow
- ignore Bob shell metadata in `.gitignore`
- remove the local `.nvim.lua` editor config from the repository

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The coverage step header comment has a typo ("95%total  coverage") and reads awkwardly. Consider changing it to something like "95% total coverage" (and keep it consistent with the actual `--cov-fail-under=95` flag below).
```suggestion
      # 3️⃣  Run the tests with coverage (fail under 95% total coverage)
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The new rationale comment block is a bit unclear/grammatically off (e.g., "trying by experience" and "95 was too much effort" without a % sign). Since this is meant to document a policy decision, it would be helpful to tighten the wording (e.g., explicitly say "95%" and use clearer phrasing).
```suggestion
      # Why 93%? Based on experience, this is currently the
      # best balance between the value of additional tests and
      # the effort required to write them. A 95% threshold
      # required too much effort for tests that mostly mocked
      # everything before a given line just to prove that it
      # executed.
      #
      # This threshold will likely continue to evolve.
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This changes the diff-cover gate to 93%, but there are repo docs that still describe the PR diff-cover threshold as 95% (e.g., SECURITY.md mentions "diff-cover enforcing 95% coverage on changed lines"). Please update those references to avoid stale documentation.

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]

Learn how to get started.
